speedTestUI.title: Internet Speed Test
speedTestUI.startMessage: Click the button below to start testing your connection speed
speedTestUI.downloadDesc: Download speed measures how fast you can receive data from the internet. The higher, the better for streaming, downloads, and browsing.
speedTestUI.uploadDesc: Upload speed measures how fast you can send data to the internet. Important for video conferences, sharing files, and uploads.
speedTestUI.pingDesc: Ping measures your connection response time in milliseconds. The lower, the better for online gaming and video calls.
speedTestUI.jitterDesc: Jitter measures ping variation. Low values indicate a stable connection, important for streaming and video calls.
speedTestUI.tip1: Connect your device directly to the router via ethernet cable for faster speeds
speedTestUI.tip2: Position the router in a central and elevated location, away from walls and obstacles
speedTestUI.tip3: Close applications and downloads you're not using to free up bandwidth
speedTestUI.tip4: Restart the router regularly to clear memory and improve performance
speedTestUI.tip5: Check for available firmware updates for your router
speedTestUI.privacyText: This test runs 100% in your browser. No personal data is collected or stored. We use public Cloudflare servers to perform speed measurements.
